issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: PixVerse R2
products.tagline: A real-time world model you can explore and change
products.summaryZh: 一个可探索和改变的实时世界模型
products.descriptionZh: PixVerse R2 是一个实时世界模型，生成持续演变的视听世界，而非固定视频片段。它在生成过程中接受文本、图像、音频和动作输入，记住会话中早先发生的内容，并实时将这些变化延续下去。R2 可扩展至更长、更连贯且可控的体验——从互动故事和角色到可玩的生成世界，皆可支持。
products.description: PixVerse R2 is a real-time world model that generates continuously evolving audiovisual worlds instead of fixed video clips. It accepts text, images, audio and actions while generating, remembers what happened earlier in the session, and carries those changes forward in real time. R2 scales to longer, more coherent and controllable experiences — powering everything from interactive stories and characters to playable generative worlds.

products.name: Bleetz Network
products.tagline: AI agent-to-agent VC fundraising & scouting network
products.summaryZh: AI代理对代理的风险投资募资与搜寻网络
products.descriptionZh: 融资已经失灵。创始人花数周时间寻找风投、研究投资主题、核查行业、阶段和地域，并发送冷邮件，却往往不知道谁才真正合适。Bleetz Network 将这一流程的第一步自动化。你的 AI agent 会与 2,000 多个真实风投的模拟 agent 匹配，向适合你初创公司的基金进行推介，并获得 YES、NO 或 MAYBE。YES 会解锁该基金的联系方式。免费，无任何附加条件。
products.description: Fundraising is broken. Founders spend weeks searching for VCs, researching investment theses, checking sectors, stages and geographies, and sending cold emails, often without knowing who is actually a good fit. Bleetz Network automates the first part of this process. Your AI agent gets matched with 2,000+ SIMULATED agents of real VC, pitches the funds that fit your startup, and gets a YES, NO or MAYBE. A YES unlocks the fund’s contact details. Free, no strings attached.

products.name: Quiver GTM
products.tagline: Run developer marketing like an engineering system
products.summaryZh: 像工程系统一样运行开发者营销
products.descriptionZh: Quiver 是一个面向技术创始人和开发者工具团队的智能体开发者营销系统。它将产品背景、客户证据、营销活动、内容、任务和结果连接在一个受控系统中。与其他 AI 写作工具不同，Quiver 为智能体提供持久上下文、版本历史、明确的生产状态、Content API、MCP 访问以及经人工批准的反馈闭环。可使用托管版 Quiver，享受团队访问管理和内置任务，或自行托管免费 MIT 许可版本。
products.description: Quiver is an agentic developer marketing system for technical founders and dev-tool teams. It keeps product context, customer evidence, campaigns, content, tasks and results connected in one controlled system. Unlike another AI writing tool, Quiver gives agents durable context, version history, explicit production states, a Content API, MCP access and a human-approved feedback loop. Use hosted Quiver with managed team access and built-in tasks, or self-host the free MIT-licensed edition.

products.name: 10xJoy
products.tagline: Discover desired outcomes + connect w/ builders who can help
products.summaryZh: 发现期望成果，并与能提供帮助的构建者建立联系
products.descriptionZh: 认识Joy，你的免费AI商业配对助手。无需明确要构建什么，就能将商业目标转化为可编辑的简报。我们的早期测试版正迎来首批构建者。分享什么由你决定；介绍通过电子邮件协调。构建者的工作范围和价格直接确定。
products.description: Meet Joy, your free AI business matchmaker. Turn business goals into an editable brief without knowing what to build. Our early beta is welcoming its first builders. You choose what to share; introductions are coordinated by email. Builder work is scoped and priced directly.

products.name: DEV·TV
products.tagline: A retro TV for GitHub, HN, Hugging Face & more: 10 channels
products.summaryZh: 一款复古电视，可收看 GitHub、HN、Hugging Face 等：10 个频道
products.descriptionZh: 大多数开发者习惯性地刷 GitHub、Hacker News、DEV 和 Hugging Face。DEV·TV 把它们变成 10 个自动播放的直播频道，就像电视一样。瞥一眼，看一条内容，然后继续写代码。把它放在办公室屏幕上，或作为远程团队常驻的标签页，它就成了一种共享语境：每个人都能看到正在升温的内容，任何人都可以指着问“你看到这个了吗？”一个 HTML 文件：无需后端、无需登录、无需构建步骤。真实源数据，内置阅读器，没有 AI 摘要。免费，MIT 许可。
products.description: Most devs check GitHub, Hacker News, DEV and Hugging Face out of habit. DEV·TV turns them into 10 live channels that play on their own, like TV. Glance, catch one story, get back to coding. Leave it on an office screen or a remote team's always-on tab and it becomes shared context: everyone sees what's rising, and anyone can point and ask "did you see this?" One HTML file: no backend, no login, no build step. Real source data, built-in reader, no AI summaries. Free and MIT-licensed.

products.name: Designeer
products.tagline: Bringing the best of the internet together
products.summaryZh: 汇聚互联网精华
products.descriptionZh: 为构建者探索互联网精华 Designeer是一个精选平台，为设计师、开发者和构建者汇聚互联网上的优质资源。在这里，你可以发现设计灵感、组件库、设计系统、AI工具、编码代理、MCP服务器以及值得学习的创作者，一切尽在一处。发现。学习。构建。展示。
products.description: Explore the Best of the Internet for Builders Designeer is a curated platform bringing the best of the internet together for designers, developers, and builders. Discover design inspiration, component libraries, design systems, AI tools, coding agents, MCP servers, and creators worth learning from, all in one place. Discover. Learn. Build. Showcase.

products.name: Wand
products.tagline: Build software at the speed of thought
products.summaryZh: 以思维的速度构建软件
products.descriptionZh: 为思考快于打字的人打造。键盘正成为瓶颈。Wand让你大声思考，而不必停下来把想法转译成提示词。随意漫谈、即时反应、话说到一半改变主意——Wand都能跟上，并把你的想法变成软件。欢迎来到后键盘时代。
products.description: For builders who think faster than they type. The keyboard is becoming the bottleneck. Wand lets you think out loud instead of stopping to translate ideas into prompts. Ramble, react, change your mind mid-sentence - Wand keeps up and turns your thoughts into software. Welcome to the post-keyboard era.

products.name: Howseen AI
products.tagline: Track how AI recommends your brand, and get cited
products.summaryZh: 跟踪AI如何推荐你的品牌，并获得引用
products.descriptionZh: 你的买家现在会问ChatGPT、Gemini和Perplexity该买哪个工具或品牌。Howseen追踪AI在ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity和Google AI Overviews中推荐的是你还是你的竞争对手，找出你完全不被提及的具体问题，并生成针对SEO和GEO优化的内容让你被引用，按影响力最高的缺口优先自动发布到你的博客。大多数工具止步于一个评分。Howseen则形成闭环：先衡量，再行动。免费查看你当前的处境。
products.description: Your buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity which tool or brand to buy. Howseen tracks whether AI recommends you or your competitors across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, finds the exact questions where you're invisible, and generates SEO & GEO-optimized content to get you cited, auto-published to your blog on the highest-impact gaps first. Most tools stop at a score. Howseen closes the loop: measure, then act. Free to see where you stand today.

products.name: Promptic
products.tagline: Optimize GenAI applications for quality and cost
products.summaryZh: 优化GenAI应用的质量和成本
products.descriptionZh: Promptic 是面向 GenAI 应用的优化平台，以更低成本实现更高质量。基于你自己的数据和业务指标，对模型进行基准测试，调优提示词和智能体，并优化工具使用。每个候选方案都会按照你真正关心的质量和成本进行评分，让你交付胜出的配置，而不是听起来正确的配置。无论你在哪里运行，仪表盘 UI、CI 还是编码智能体，都能使用。
products.description: Promptic is the optimization platform for GenAI applications, better quality at lower cost. Benchmark models, tune prompts and agents, and optimize tool use against your own data and business metrics. Every candidate is scored on the quality and cost you actually care about, so you ship the configuration that wins instead of the one that sounded right. Runs wherever you are, dashboard UI, your CI, or your coding agent.

products.name: SocialGPT
products.tagline: Edit videos by chatting with your timeline
products.summaryZh: 通过与时间线对话来编辑视频
products.descriptionZh: 上传你的素材，告诉 SocialGPT 要改什么。精简剪辑，添加字幕，加入 B-roll、音乐和音效。通过聊天持续调整，或自行编辑时间线。适合不想学习所有剪辑工具的创作者和企业主。
products.description: Upload your footage and tell SocialGPT what to change. Tighten the cut, add captions, bring in B-roll, music, and sound effects. Keep refining through chat or edit the timeline yourself. For creators and business owners who want to make videos without learning every editing tool.

products.name: ShroomPen
products.tagline: Reply, rewrite, fix grammar, translate with single extension
products.summaryZh: 回复、重写、修正语法、使用单一扩展名翻译
products.descriptionZh: ShroomPen 是一款隐私优先的浏览器写作助手，让你在任何网站上即时回复、改写、修正语法或翻译文本，无需将敏感数据发送至云端。它在 AI 便捷性与绝对数据隐私之间取得平衡，将所有页面、字段、标签页和会话上下文安全保存在你的设备上，让你完全掌控日常网页工作流程。
products.description: ShroomPen is a privacy-first browser writing assistant that lets you instantly reply, rewrite, fix grammar, or translate text across any website without sending sensitive data to the cloud. Designed to balance AI convenience with absolute data privacy, it keeps all your page, field, tab, and session context securely on your device, giving you complete control over your everyday web workflow.

products.name: Jango
products.tagline: Test multi-user apps with AI agents that act like real users
products.summaryZh: 使用像真实用户一样行动的AI代理测试多用户应用
products.descriptionZh: Jango 让你测试应用中需要多人参与的部分。它为你的应用提供一组 AI 用户，每个用户都有自己的浏览器、账号、目标和记忆。将 Jango 指向你的开发 URL，观察他们实时登录并相互交互。你可以指挥他们，以你自己的身份加入，或接管任意用户的屏幕。最后你会得到一份包含操作、错误和截图的报告。可使用你自己的 AI 密钥或 Jango 托管的 AI。支持 Mac。
products.description: Jango lets you test the parts of your app that need more than one person. It gives your app a group of AI users, each with its own browser, account, goals and memory. Point Jango at your dev URL and watch them sign in and interact with each other in real time. Direct them, join in as yourself, or take control of any user's screen. At the end you get a report with actions, errors and screenshots. Use your own AI key or Jango's managed AI. Available on Mac.

products.name: Donna
products.tagline: Schedule multiple meetings with one link
products.summaryZh: 用一个链接安排多个会议
products.descriptionZh: Donna 让你能将一系列会议合并为一个预约链接。无需为每次通话发送不同链接，一个链接即可串联所有会议，并支持设置会议间隔时间、在上一会议完成前锁定下一会议等条件。它还内置了工作流，用于优先处理重要会议、填补取消的空档、跨团队分配会议等。
products.description: Donna lets you combine a sequence of meetings into a single booking link. Instead of sending different links for every call, one link chains all meetings together with conditions like setting time gaps between meetings or keeping the next meeting locked until the previous one is completed. It also includes built-in workflows to prioritize important meetings, fill cancellations, route meetings across teams, and more.

products.name: Squints
products.tagline: Design tools for the live web
products.summaryZh: 为实时网络而设计工具
products.descriptionZh: Squints 将设计工具叠加在任何实时网页之上。测量间距、拖出参考线、叠加列网格、以任意格式拾取颜色、查看实际渲染的字体，以及放慢或拖动任意动画。免费，无需账户，无追踪。
products.description: Squints puts design tools on top of any live web page. Measure spacing, drag out guides, overlay a column grid, pick colours in any format, see the font that actually rendered, and slow down or scrub any animation. Free, no account, no tracking.

products.name: Basedash MCP write
products.tagline: Build charts and dashboards from Cursor and Claude
products.summaryZh: 从 Cursor 和 Claude 构建图表和仪表板
products.descriptionZh: Basedash MCP 现在不仅能读取，还能写入。在 Cursor、Claude 或任何 MCP 客户端中，你可以请求生成一张图表或整个仪表盘——Basedash 会探索 schema、编写并验证 SQL、选择可视化方式并完成布局。结果会以真实的 Basedash 图表返回，附带持久链接和渲染图像，因此你可以继续在 IDE 中迭代，或与团队分享。编辑方式同样如此：“按套餐拆分”会更新实时图表。不只是读取。还能写入。
products.description: Basedash MCP can now write, not just read. From Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client, ask for a chart or a whole dashboard—Basedash explores the schema, writes and validates the SQL, picks the visualization, and lays it out. The result comes back as a real Basedash chart with a durable link and a rendered image, so you can keep iterating in the IDE or share it with the team. Edit it the same way: “break it out by plan” updates the live chart. Not just read. Write.

products.name: Kaiku
products.tagline: The task tracker your AI agents already know how to use
products.summaryZh: 你的AI代理已经知道如何使用的任务跟踪器
products.descriptionZh: 一个为团队打造的任务追踪器和 wiki，这些团队的工作正越来越多地由 AI 智能体完成。它说大多数公司已在使用的追踪器的 API，因此你的智能体所用的 MCP 服务器无需改动即可工作。内置面向 Claude Code 和 Cursor 的 MCP 服务器，你在评论中调用的智能体只提议、从不决定，每次智能体运行的成本都记录在它所处理的问题上。
products.description: A task tracker and wiki built for teams whose work is increasingly done by AI agents. It speaks the API of the tracker most companies already run, so the MCP servers your agents use work unchanged. Built-in MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor, agents you call in a comment that propose but never decide, and every agent run's cost recorded on the issue it worked on.

products.name: Kapshot
products.tagline: Screen recordings that look like you edited them
products.summaryZh: 看起来像经过剪辑的屏幕录制
products.descriptionZh: Kapshot 是一款屏幕录制工具，专为需要精美产品演示、教程和视频的人设计，无需花费时间剪辑。无需先录制屏幕，再打开视频编辑器添加缩放、修正光标、为每次交互调整画面，Kapshot 在录制时自动完成这些美化。
products.description: Kapshot is a screen recorder for people who need polished product demos, tutorials, and videos, without spending time editing them. Instead of recording your screen and then opening a video editor to add zooms, fix the cursor, and frame every interaction, Kapshot does the polish automatically while you record.

products.name: Fit Receipt
products.tagline: A private fitting agent that knows when to call JEV
products.summaryZh: 一位私人试衣代理，懂得何时召唤JEV
products.descriptionZh: 虚拟试穿内衣；每一次选择都附有AI判断凭据。Fit Receipt是一个参考实现。智能体负责对话；代码守护事实与定价。JEV（TypeSafe）是一种判断模型，能在约300毫秒内以校准后的置信度对权衡进行评分——而非长篇大论。低置信度的结果保持未决；判断会被记录；没有JEV也能运行。照片保留在你的浏览器中；服务器不存储照片。JEV只看到结构化字段，从不接触照片。API有速率限制。基于Vercel并开源。
products.description: Try on lingerie virtually; every pick has an AI judgment receipt. Fit Receipt is a reference implementation. The agent handles chat; code protects facts and pricing. JEV (TypeSafe) is a judgment model that scores trade-offs with calibrated confidence in ~300ms—not essays. Low-confidence results stay unresolved; judgments are recorded; works without JEV. Photos stay in your browser; no server photo storage. JEV sees typed fields, never the photo. Rate-limited API. Vercel + open source.

products.name: Once UI 2.0
products.tagline: Builds consistent React apps for developers and AI agents
products.summaryZh: 为开发者和AI代理构建一致的React应用
products.descriptionZh: Once UI 是一个开源设计系统，用于以更少的重复代码构建精致的 React 产品。使用可读的原语组合布局，采用共享的组件与设计令牌系统，并让产品在成长过程中保持一致。2.0 版本为你和你的编码代理提供了更清晰的工作方式。其组件目录、精简规则和任务指南帮助代理正确使用该系统；其基础与可预测的 API 让你更容易理解输出。
products.description: Once UI is an open-source design system for building polished React products with less repetitive code. Compose layouts with readable primitives, use a shared system of components and design tokens, and keep the result consistent as your product grows. Version 2.0 gives both you and your coding agent a clearer way to work. Its component catalog, compact rules, and task guides help agents use the system correctly; its foundations and predictable APIs make the output easier for you to understand.

products.name: FRCTL
products.tagline: Mind-Bending Media and Live Visuals
products.summaryZh: 令人脑洞大开的媒体与现场视觉
products.descriptionZh: FRCTL 是一个引擎，涵盖艺术家在浏览器中发布和运行的一切。导入你自己的素材或创建生成式着色器场景。打造一种视觉风格，然后提取封面图、Spotify Canvas 或社交短片。以直接全屏输出实时运行循环。190 多种效果，无限调制，可将音频路由至任意参数。实时模式下支持摄像头和画布捕捉。直接在 Collective 中出售你的预设或循环，或在成员动态中发帖和评论。创作、表演、变现、协作。
products.description: FRCTL is one engine for everything an artist ships and runs in the browser. Import your own footage or create generative shader scenes. Build a look, then pull cover art, a Spotify Canvas or a social clip. Run the loop live with direct full screen output. 190+ effects with infinite modulation and route audio into any parameter. Camera and canvas capture in live mode. Sell your presets or loops right in the Collective or post and comment on the member feed. Create, perform, monetize, collab.
